fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway to keep the travel lane clear for emergency vehicles.
• Keep a gate or opening in the perimeter fencing accessible from the front to allow responders to reach the rear of the property on foot.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the detached structure to allow responders to move around it without obstruction.
• Mark the rear of the property with a visible address or unit identifier so responders arriving on foot can confirm their location.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so arriving emergency vehicles have room to stage and turn around.
• Thin dense vegetation along the property perimeter to give responders a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Mow or cut tall grass areas near the house and any outbuildings before dry season.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees near the house to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Remove or cut back shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Cut brush in the dense brush area closest to the house to reduce the amount of burnable material near it.
• Maintain mowed or cleared grass along the full length of the driveway to keep the single access route passable.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches that could block emergency vehicle access.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible to emergency responders approaching from the road.
• Clear a path around the rear of the structure wide enough for a person to walk through without obstruction.
• Cut back mixed vegetation on the side of the house with limited rear access to allow movement around the building.
• Keep grass in open areas adjacent to the house cut short, especially where it connects to shrubs or tree clusters.
• Remove dead grass, dead shrubs, and any dried plant material from the areas immediately surrounding the structure.
